headline: SEBI issues release order for Keynote Enterprises in TV Vision matter
hook: Attachment order lifted for Keynote Enterprises
summary: SEBI has issued a release order dated September 30, 2026, concerning Keynote Enterprises Pvt Ltd in the matter of TV Vision Ltd. This procedural recovery proceeding update relates to enforcement actions previously initiated by the regulator. Retail investors holding shares in TV Vision Ltd should note ongoing regulatory and recovery actions involving entities connected to the firm.
why_it_matters: Regulatory recovery actions continue for TV Vision
